title: Timer bug
body:
Whenether I use a timer with my habit, pause button (||) does not save the time. After resume (|>) the time goes again from the start value. For example i start 15 min. behaviour. Stop after 3 min., resume and again it counts 15 minutes. This happens on iOS. Otherwise the app is great.

Edit: I have a few time scenerio, when after resuming timer I locked the screen (there was 6 min. left). After unclock there where 9 minutes left.
